sourceFile: 7. BRS-161014 Report Test Magnet Tension Speed Changing_230822_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The report is comparable, but the draft misidentifies the changed factor and has unreliable outcome grouping/stat evidence.
issues: Changed factor should be tension test speed, not the file name or material.
Baseline and changed conditions should be 3mm/min and 20mm/min from the purpose/table.
Outcome table is duplicated with conflicting sample counts.
Statistics cite too few/unclear rows and include Report!28 not shown in context.
correctionPlan: Set change domain to test method/process and changed factor to tension speed.
Define compared conditions as QM 3mm/min versus approval-sheet 20mm/min.
Create one measurement outcome for magnet tension results.
Recompute sample count and summary stats from all visible table rows.
Cite the purpose row and all result table rows supporting the comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are not sufficient as final evidence until all table rows used for stats are cited.
